name: Last Stand
description:
As death looms, you sacrifice everything to save your allies. You must choose this on your turn before making a Death Check. You are no longer Stunned and remove any other conditions; your Resolve refills to its maximum; you are immune to all Damage; your Melee and Accuracy increase by 1; and any Damage you inflict ignores Armor.

When your turn ends, you die, and nothing can save you.
